title: Update 19.1 for Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central 2021 Release Wave 2
summary: Update 19.1 for Business Central 2021 Release Wave 2 provides hotfixes, feature enhancements including environment copying, barcode support, and warehouse improvements, plus localization updates for Mexico and US tax forms, and expansion to new countries.
features: Shipping agent information copied to warehouse shipments
CFDI Carta de Porte compliance for Mexico
